$description: Anvil UI design tokens. Pulled from Figma by scripts/figma/export-tokens.js; never edit by hand.

default.$description: Extension status family: AI agent states (thinking, streaming, tools, citations): base tone (fills, icons).

foreground.$description: Extension status family: AI agent states (thinking, streaming, tools, citations): text on the default tone.

soft.$description: Extension status family: AI agent states (thinking, streaming, tools, citations): soft tone, borders on subtle backgrounds.

strong.$description: Extension status family: AI agent states (thinking, streaming, tools, citations): strongest tone, text on subtle backgrounds.

subtle.$description: Extension status family: AI agent states (thinking, streaming, tools, citations): subtle background tint.

muted.$description: shadcn --muted. Muted surfaces, table stripes, skeletons.

sidebar-accent.$description: shadcn --sidebar-accent. Surface that sits on the page background.

sidebar-primary.$description: shadcn --sidebar-primary. Surface that sits on the page background.

columns.$description: Layout token for grids and viewports.

gutter.$description: Layout token for grids and viewports.

margin.$description: Layout token for grids and viewports.

lg.$description: Tailwind rounded-lg (8px desktop). shadcn: var(--radius) — this is --radius.

container-height.$description: Default height of the shell container. Modes: full screen / side panel / popover / mobile. In code, set via [data-surface] on the shell root.

container-width.$description: Default width of the shell container. Modes: full screen / side panel / popover / mobile. In code, set via [data-surface] on the shell root.

gap.$description: Space between turns in the thread. Modes: full screen / side panel / popover / mobile. In code, set via [data-surface] on the shell root.

header-height.$description: Height of the shell header. Modes: full screen / side panel / popover / mobile. In code, set via [data-surface] on the shell root.

padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding of the thread and composer. Modes: full screen / side panel / popover / mobile. In code, set via [data-surface] on the shell root.

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding of the thread. Modes: full screen / side panel / popover / mobile. In code, set via [data-surface] on the shell root.

thread-max.$description: Max width of the conversation column. Modes: full screen / side panel / popover / mobile. In code, set via [data-surface] on the shell root.

widget-max.$description: Max width of widgets and cards inside a message. Modes: full screen / side panel / popover / mobile. In code, set via [data-surface] on the shell root.

heading.$description: Custom font-heading. Display and headings (Funnel Sans).

sans.$description: Tailwind font-sans. Body and UI text (Inter).

2xl.$description: Line height for text-2xl: 32px desktop / 32px mobile (Tailwind default).

2xs.$description: Line height for text-2xs: 14px desktop / 14px mobile (Tailwind default).

3xl.$description: Line height for text-3xl: 40px desktop / 36px mobile (Tailwind default).

4xl.$description: Line height for text-4xl: 44px desktop / 40px mobile (Tailwind default).

5xl.$description: Line height for text-5xl: 48px desktop / 40px mobile (Tailwind default).

6xl.$description: Line height for text-6xl: 56px desktop / 48px mobile (Tailwind default).

base.$description: Line height for text-base: 24px desktop / 24px mobile (Tailwind default).

sm.$description: Line height for text-sm: 20px desktop / 20px mobile (Tailwind default).

xl.$description: Line height for text-xl: 28px desktop / 28px mobile (Tailwind default).

xs.$description: Line height for text-xs: 16px desktop / 16px mobile (Tailwind default).
shadow-xs · Inputs, selects, checkboxes, radio buttons and outline buttons. · 0 1px 2px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)

sm.$description: shadow-sm · Cards, chat attachments, chips and the toggle handle. · 0 1px 4px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)

md.$description: shadow-md · Hovered cards and tooltips. · 0 2px 8px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.16)

lg.$description: shadow-lg · Dropdowns, popovers, hover cards and floating toolbars. · 0 8px 24px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.16)

xl.$description: shadow-xl · Toasts and hovered event cards. · 0 8px 28px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.24), 0 1px 3px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)

2xl.$description: shadow-2xl · Modals, drawers and sheets. · 0 16px 64px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.24)

inner.$description: inset-shadow-xs · Input wells and toggle tracks. · inset 0 1px 2px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)

top.$description: shadow-top (custom) · Casts upward: sticky footers, composer docks, modal footers. · 0 -4px 12px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)

bottom.$description: shadow-bottom (custom) · Casts downward: sticky headers and top bars. · 0 4px 12px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)

drag.$description: shadow-drag (custom) · Items while being dragged. · 0 6px 24px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.16), 0 1px 3px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)

ring.$description: ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background · Keyboard focus on every interactive element. Mode-aware. · 0 0px 0px 4px rgb(180 222 253 / 1), 0 0px 0px 2px rgb(255 255 255 / 1)

raised.$description: Floating surfaces anchored to a trigger: Popover, Dropdown Menu, Menu, Combobox list, Date Picker, hover card. Same values as shadow/lg.

modal.$description: Surfaces above a scrim: Dialog, Alert Dialog, Sheet, Drawer. Same values as shadow/xl.

6xl.$description: font-heading text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight · 56/56 · Funnel Sans SemiBold.

5xl.$description: font-heading text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight · 48/48 · Funnel Sans SemiBold.

4xl.$description: font-heading text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight · 40/44 · Funnel Sans SemiBold.

3xl.$description: font-heading text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight · 32/40 · Funnel Sans SemiBold.

2xl.$description: font-heading text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight · 24/32 · Funnel Sans SemiBold.

xl.$description: font-heading text-xl font-semibold · 20/28 · Funnel Sans SemiBold.

link.$description: text-base font-medium underline underline-offset-4 · 16/24 · Inter Medium.
